description: Hire a human negotiator (RentAKaren) to deal with a counterparty for you — lower a bill, win a refund, renegotiate rent or a subscription. You pay an hourly rate up to a minutes cap, plus a flat bonus per objective you approve as met. The escrow (hourlyRateCents × capMinutes / 60 + every objective bonus) plus the platform fee is taken from your wallet up front; the response reports escrowedCents, platformFeeCents and totalChargeCents (what the wallet is debited). Applicants then apply. The hosted connector exposes list_negotiation_applicants and respond_to_applicant; local rentahuman-mcp users review and choose applicants through the Karen REST API or negotiation page. At settlement only approved hours and approved bonuses are paid; everything unused is refunded to your wallet, and billing never exceeds the cap. authorization.rightsConfirmed must be true: only post accounts you hold or are authorized to negotiate. If the response shows funding.funded false, the negotiation is pending_funding. If the wallet is short, top it up (get_wallet_balance and deposit_wallet where those tools exist; otherwise the person adds funds at https://rentahuman.ai/account/wallet), then call fund_negotiation. Not idempotent: on a failed call, check list_negotiations before retrying. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

mayAgreeTo.description: What the negotiator may agree to on your behalf without checking back.
mayAgreeTo.title: maxLength(1000)

mayDisclose.description: What the negotiator may disclose to the counterparty (account details, history).
mayDisclose.title: maxLength(1000)

neverCommitTo.description: Hard limits the negotiator must never commit you to.
neverCommitTo.title: maxItems(10)

recordingAllowed.description: Whether the negotiator may record calls (each opens with "This call is being recorded."). Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized in get_negotiation. Defaults to false.

rightsConfirmed.description: Must be true: you hold or are authorized to negotiate this account.

capMinutes.description: Maximum billable minutes (30-2400, multiple of 15). Billing never exceeds this cap.
capMinutes.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2400)

context.description: Background the negotiator needs: account situation, history, leverage, deadlines.
context.title: maxLength(4000)

counterparty.description: Who the negotiator will deal with, e.g. "Comcast"
counterparty.title: maxLength(120)

documentUrls.description: Up to 10 https links to supporting documents.

items.description: a string at most 2048 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(2048)

documentUrls.title: maxItems(10)

hourlyRateCents.description: Hourly rate in cents. Defaults to 2500.
hourlyRateCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(50000)

objectives.description: 1-5 objectives, each { description, target, bonusCents }. Objective IDs (obj_1, obj_2, ...) follow this order.

bonusCents.description: Flat bonus in cents paid only if you approve this objective as met. Escrowed up front; refunded if not approved.
bonusCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(500000)

description.description: What the negotiator should achieve, e.g. "Lower my bill"
description.title: maxLength(200)

objectives.title: maxItems(5)

title.description: Short title, e.g. "Lower my Comcast bill"
title.title: maxLength(120)

name: create_negotiation
title: Hire a negotiator
